facts.statement: Members in good account standing before 2 May 2011 received 45 days of free play as a welcome-back gift.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A German-language SOE 'Welcome Back' news post (posted about six days before the 2011-05-21 capture, exact date not shown) announcing login compensation after a downtime period. It lists a 45-day free play grant for members in good standing, 20,000 in-game coins for lifetime members, and a seven-day daily login gift series with a lifetime-member bonus lot.
